slovenia.title: Flag of the Republic of Slovenia

colors.note: A pan-Slavic colour representing loyalty and the Adriatic Sea.
A pan-Slavic colour representing the blood shed in the struggle for independence.
The three gold stars on the coat of arms are taken from the historic Counts of Celje crest.

desc:
- Three equal horizontal bands of white, blue, and red (pan-Slavic colours) with the national coat of arms at the upper hoist
- The coat of arms shows a white Mount Triglav with three blue wavy lines below it and three six-pointed gold stars above
- Adopted on 27 June 1991, two days after Slovenia declared independence from Yugoslavia
trivia:
- Mount Triglav, at 2,864 m, is Slovenia's highest peak and a national symbol
- The wavy lines represent the Adriatic Sea and the country's rivers
- The three stars come from the crest of the medieval Counts of Celje — the last great Slovene aristocratic dynasty
